country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Brighton Digital Exchange (BDX) data centre
developer: Brighton Digital Exchange Co-operative / Wired Sussex / Sudlows
notes: The GBP700,000 BDX project converted part of New England House, Brighton into a 270 sq m cooperative data-centre/digital-exchange facility for Brighton's digital businesses; Sudlows lists critical power, UPS, generator, CRAC, fire suppression and security components.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: VIRTUS Saunderton Campus
developer: VIRTUS Data Centres (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres / Macquarie)
notes: VIRTUS Saunderton Campus: four data-centre buildings on a 50-acre former Molins factory site at Saunderton (near High Wycombe); official spec sheet states 78MW IT load; construction of four buildings began (BBC, May 2025) with operations expected from 2026.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: West London Technology Park
notes: Greystoke describes a 90MW project next to the M25 in Buckinghamshire (Iver area) with outline/reserved-matters activity; January 2026 reporting says the UK government admitted an error and permission was likely to be quashed, so current planning status is uncertain (kept unknown).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pinewood South Data Centre
notes: Pinewood submitted a Buckinghamshire Council outline application (27 Jun 2025) for a ~55,030 sqm data centre on the Pinewood South site (19.5 ha, Iver Heath); Pinewood later reported the council resolved to grant planning permission (Dec 2025). Capacity/end-user not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Denham Data Centre
notes: Outline proposal for a hyperscale data centre on land north of the M40 / both sides of Denham Court Drive (former car-boot site, ~60,000 sqm on Green Belt); reporting notes local council objections; planned for 2028 with expansions through 2030.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Redcentric Elland Data Centre
notes: Operational Tier-3-aligned facility at Lowfields Business Park, Elland, Calderdale; official Redcentric datasheet gives 37,000 sq ft of floor space and carrier-neutral colocation. MW capacity not stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Lloyds Copley Data Centre
notes: Lloyds-owned office and data centre campus on Wakefield Road/Copley near Halifax was reported for sale with Lloyds expected to exit in 2025; current operating/future status should be rechecked before use.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Exaflops Halifax
notes: Directory listing for Exaflops at Calderdale Business Park, Halifax, offering IaaS/HPC/AI/ML/GPU services; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: CAMRO Data Park (Elean Business Park, Sutton)
notes: Full planning approval granted by Cambridgeshire County Council (March 2023) for CAMRO, a 700,000 sq ft (65,000 sqm) data centre campus on a 43-acre site at Elean Business Park, Sutton-in-the-Isle; camro.co.uk confirms consent with power available on site (up to 180MVA per Savills). Capacity MW not fixed; site later became the basis for AiOnX/SWI's 330MW plans.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AiOnX / SWI Group Sutton-in-the-Isle 330MW data centre campus
notes: AiOnX/SWI announced (30 Jun 2025) a first UK hyperscale campus at Sutton-in-the-Isle, Cambridgeshire, scaled to 330MW at full build-out (~GBP3bn investment), targeting the Cambridge-Peterborough corridor; announcement-level evidence, no planning application surfaced in this pass - status kept announced.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Quest Park Data Centre Campus, Ampthill Road / Stewartby
notes: Secretary of State issued a Section 35 direction (15 Jun 2026) bringing QuestPit's 143-acre data centre campus at Ampthill Road, Stewartby (Central Bedfordshire) into the DCO/NSIP route under Planning Act 2008; DCD reports four buildings and up to 720MW IT capacity (project site claims ~1GW long-term); gas-bridge power discussed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Amazon Linmere Island / Houghton Regis data centre campus
developer: Amazon Data Services UK Ltd / Collier Properties LLC
notes: Two-building data centre campus at Linmere Island within the Houghton Regis North 1 development (Central Bedfordshire), submitted early 2025 by Collier Properties LLC (AWS partner); approved July 2025 and approved again after a legal challenge; Amazon Data Services UK holds an Environment Agency permit application for the back-up generation (Dec 2024). Capacity not disclosed (~114.8 GWh/yr electricity reported).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: nLighten Chester MAN1
notes: Operational edge colocation data centre at Dunkirk Trading Estate, Chester Gate (between Chester and Ellesmere Port); nLighten lists 2,040 sqm dedicated colocation space and 2,800 kW / 6,000 kW end-state site capacity (Tier III standard).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Birmingham
name: nLighten Birmingham BHX1
notes: Operational edge colocation facility at The Garrison, Technology Park (3 Westley St), Birmingham; nLighten lists 930 sqm dedicated colocation space and 9,600 kW power.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Birmingham
name: Pulsant Birmingham WM-1 / SCC Cole Valley
notes: Pulsant acquired SCC data centres including Birmingham/Cole Valley (WM-1); reporting gives 2MW power capacity and 25,000 sq ft white space across five data halls; Pulsant official page confirms the WM-1 colocation site.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Leeds
name: nLighten Leeds LBA1
notes: Operational edge colocation facility in south-west Leeds; nLighten lists 650 sqm dedicated colocation space and 3,600 kW power.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Leeds
name: aql Leeds DC1/DC2/DC3 Salem Chapel
notes: Long-established carrier-neutral Leeds colocation hub at Hunslet Road/Salem Chapel, home to IXLeeds; public sources give rack counts (~130 racks across three phases) but not MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Leeds
name: aql Leeds DC5 Apex Way
notes: Operational shared data centre at Apex Way, Leeds; Colo-X reports 2MW customer power (2016) with scope to double.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Salford
name: Halo West Salford Data Centre (Peel Waters)
developer: Digital Land & Development / DLD Salford with Peel Waters
notes: Unanimously approved (Salford Council) GBP250m data centre at the former White's reclamation site off Liverpool Road between Eccles and Irlam (Peel Waters 'City Gateway'); ~66,300 sq ft data hall/office/plant; MW capacity not found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Salford
name: Media Stream AI Anchorage Place Data Centre
notes: MSAI announced a GBP50m canal-cooled AI data centre at Anchorage Place/MediaCity (Salford), reported as 2MW by directories; April 2026 investigative reporting questioned whether the claimed data centre was actually built, so status kept unknown.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City and Borough of Wakefield
name: Node4 Leeds Data Centre / Wakefield DC3
notes: Operational Node4 facility at Pope Street, Normanton, Wakefield district; Node4 lists 26,000 sq ft and 450 racks across four halls (Tier 3+); Colo-X reports 2MW IT load.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Avonmouth Data Centre (Viridor ERF site)
developer: Rivington Energy / Viridor (Avonmouth Data Centre Ltd)
notes: Environment Agency permit application (EPR/ZP3925MP/A001) by Avonmouth Data Centre Ltd for the Avonmouth Data Centre at Severn Road, Pilning/Avonmouth BS11 0YU; Bristol City Council planning screening request describes change of use of the former polymers recycling facility at the Viridor Avonmouth ERF; Viridor/Rivington plan a 200MW EfW-powered DC portfolio with the first project ~40MW AI-ready, potentially operational 2027.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
division: England - City of Kingston upon Hull
name: KCOM Hull City Centre Data Centre
notes: KCOM markets colocation from its Hull city centre data centre with secure cabinets, dual power, cooling, backup generators and remote hands; 99.999% network availability claimed. Capacity not publicly stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: iomart / Easyspace Leicester Data Centre DC4
notes: iomart's Leicester DC4 (16 Berkley Street) is a Tier 2 colocation facility ~1km north-west of the city centre with ~620 sqm across two data halls, carrier-neutral connectivity, dual feeds, UPS and diesel generators; ~270 racks. IT load MW not stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Deep Green DG02 York
notes: Deep Green's York pipeline site (DG02) at/near Monks Cross/LNER Community Stadium with waste heat intended for local heat users; directory/posts cite ~500 kW capacity and RFS in 2026/early 2027; City of York Council asset papers note a Community Stadium data centre proposal.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Goonhilly Earth Station Data Centre
notes: Goonhilly says its Earth Station HQ on Goonhilly Downs, Helston is home to Cornwall's only data centre, opened 2019 with ~90 racks / 2,000 sqm, redundant power, CRAC cooling, liquid-immersion capability and fibre links to London; capacity MW not stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: ITPS Angel House Data Centre (Chester-le-Street)
notes: ITPS lists its Chester-le-Street, County Durham address and data-centre services; third-party colocation records identify Angel House as a ~33,000 sq ft, 2 MW colocation/enterprise data centre. Older industry coverage reports Keysource upgrade/expansion work at the facility.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Mill Hill County Durham Data Centre Power Project
notes: AVK-SEG's October 2025 release says its UK pipeline for data-centre-focused low-carbon behind-the-meter power includes a 30 MW consented site at Mill Hill, County Durham. Evidence is strongest for the power/microgrid infrastructure serving data centres; end data-centre operator not named.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hawthorn Pit Data Centre and BESS Hybrid Project
notes: DCD reports Innova submitted data centre proposals (Oct 2025) including a 500MW hybrid data-centre/BESS project at Hawthorn Pit, County Durham; Innova's site shows the application in progress. Treated as planned/submitted grid-queue proposal; no local planning consent found in this pass.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: UK Servers Continuity House Datacentre
notes: UK Servers says Continuity House (205 Torrington Avenue, Coventry) opened early 2023 after a ground-up build to Tier III/IV design: 20,000 sq ft, initial 300 racks, 3 MW onsite power from diverse 11kV supplies and 4 MW backup generation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: UK Servers 211 Coventry Datacentre
notes: UK Servers says its 211 Coventry datacentre opened December 2011 with 80 racks across two data halls, N+1 UPS, 32A max load per rack and 2 x 375 kVA generators. No MW IT load stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Bacloud Coventry data center
notes: Bacloud describes its Coventry data centre (established 2004) with over 300 server racks in the heart of the UK; directory-level evidence, capacity MW not stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pioneer Park Clean Energy and AI Data Centre Campus (Moorside)
developer: BEC / Energy Coast West Cumbria Ltd; Cumberland Council; Nuclear Decommissioning Authority
notes: Pioneer Park is a ~400-acre clean energy development opportunity adjacent to Sellafield (Moorside, West Cumbria); BEC's prospectus/masterplanning (Mott MacDonald/WSP appointed, masterplanning began Mar 2026) explores data-centre/AI infrastructure with direct-line power by 2030; NDA announced GBP1m funding. Data-centre component is potential/masterplan-level, no firm facility or MW - status kept announced.
